description: High-intensity, match-speed drills for technically refined players. Focus on marginal gains under full pressure.

drills.name: High-Speed Rondo (6v2)
drills.instructions: 6 players in 8m circle, 2 defenders inside. Keep possession one-touch. Rotate defenders every 2 minutes. Progress: reduce circle to 6m.
drills.coach_tip: Scan before you receive. Play away from pressure before it arrives.
drills.success_criteria: Maintain possession for 90 seconds without losing the ball.

drills.name: Shooting Under Full Pressure
drills.instructions: Receive pass with defender closing from behind. First-time or two-touch shot. Defender applies full pressure. 20 attempts each foot. Log hit rate.
drills.coach_tip: Placement beats power at this level. Choose corner early and commit.
drills.success_criteria: 12 of 20 shots on target under full pressure.

drills.name: Overspeed Dribble Sprint
drills.instructions: Attach resistance band. Dribble 20m at full speed against resistance. Remove band and repeat — body feels accelerated. 6 reps, full recovery between.
drills.coach_tip: Push the ball further ahead than feels comfortable. Trust your pace to recover it.
drills.success_criteria: Maintain ball control through all 6 reps without loss.

drills.name: Technical Quality Under Fatigue
drills.instructions: Complete a high-intensity sprint circuit (4 x 30m at 95%). Immediately perform 10 technical actions (passes, controls, turns). Video and review. Repeat 3 times.
drills.coach_tip: Elite consistency means your mechanics survive fatigue. This drill proves it.
drills.success_criteria: Technical quality (rated 1-10) drops by less than 1 point after sprints.

drills.name: Pre-Scan Rondo
drills.instructions: 4v1 in 6m box. Rule: player must look up (scan) at least twice before receiving. If they don't scan, pass doesn't count. Rotate defender every 90 sec.
drills.coach_tip: The best players make decisions before the ball arrives. Scanning is non-negotiable.
